title: Boss health bar
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Lanterns Underroot game UI ASSET sheet,not screenshot. Handpainted illustratedfantasy, darkteal/weatheredrootwood/antiquegold/cream,cleanreadablesilhouettes,restrainedornaments. Flatfront UIelevation,no3Dperspective. Truealpha outsidecomponents,no scenery/characters/faces/text/letters/numbers/UIlayout/castshadows/hazebackground. Eachcompletecomponentisolatedwith60pxpaddinginequalcells,noclip,nooverlap. Exactly4separatecomponents2x2on1536square. Row1 LEFT wideornateemptybossbarFRAMEwithtransparentlongcenter,nohealthfill;RIGHT isolateddarktealemptyTRACK roundedrectangle matchingframeinneraspect. DoNOTflattenintofourcompletehealthbars.
